timeline.summary: Asian Paints Ltd’s Board, led by **Jeyamurugan Jeyamurugan** and **Ramalingam Ramalingamjeyapandiayan**, will meet on **May 29, 2026**, to approve FY26 audited results and recommend final dividend.

Asian Paints’ management, led by **Jeyamurugan Ramalingam** (CFO & Company Secretary) and **Jeyapandiyan R Jeyamurugan**, will host in-person Analyst/Investor Meet on **June 1, 2026, in Mumbai (1:00–2:00 PM & 4:30–5:30 PM).

Asian Paints’ **Jeyamurugan R. Jeyapandiyan (CFO & Company Secretary)** and **Ramalingam Jeyamurugan** will attend Morgan Stanley’s *Investment Forum 2026* (June 2) and BoFA India’s *Conference One on One* (June 3) in Mumbai.
Asian Paints reported Q4 FY26 standalone revenue of ₹7,920 Cr and PAT of ₹1,161 Cr, recommending a final dividend of ₹23 per share.
Asian Paints submitted the audio recording link for its Q4 and FY26 investor conference held on May 29, 2026.
